notes.title: LudoNarracon Sale - Special Stream
notes.notes:
To celebrate LudoNarracon 2025 we stream this special interview about games, art, and creativity.

Together with Seorse Dunbar from Adventure Games Podcast we discuss story-driven games (Alan Wake 2, Disco Elysium, Death Stranding) and the special journey of Benign Land, from immersive art installation to game on STEAM.

https://adventuregamespodcast.com/podcast/2025/2/3/interview-with-leandro-of-afternature-productions-benign-land
https://afternatureproductions.com/
https://www.leandrosntolas.com/benign-land-2024/
